summary.zh: 给出架构取舍并写成决策记录
summary.en: Weigh architecture options and write ADRs

description.zh: 围绕单体还是微服务、数据库选型、扩展上限等问题给出带理由的结论，并整理成 ADR 和 Mermaid 图。适合在重构或新项目动手前先把技术方向定下来。
description.en: Works through monolith versus microservices, database choice and scaling limits, then writes an ADR with the reasoning and Mermaid diagrams. Worth loading before a refactor or new project locks in a technical direction.
